query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword(s) to search the Ad Library for (e.g. "solar panels"). Leave empty when collecting by page URLs.

pageUrls.title: Page URLs
pageUrls.description: Optional list of Facebook page URLs (Ad Library, profile, or numeric page URLs). When provided, all ads from these pages are collected and the search query is ignored.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to search within (e.g. US, GB, EG).

status.title: Active status
status.description: Whether to collect active, inactive, or all ads.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: How to match the search query.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to collect. Use 0 for no limit (collect everything available). When collecting by page URLs, this limit applies per page.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Number of ads requested per API call (max ~30).

rateLimitDelay.title: Rate limit delay (seconds)
rateLimitDelay.description: Base delay between requests, in seconds, to avoid being rate limited.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used for outgoing requests. Residential proxies are strongly recommended to avoid blocks.
